query:
SELECT m.map_id "map_id!: i32", m.is_randommap, m.name,
            (SELECT json_group_array(mp.prov_count)
             FROM map_planes mp
             WHERE mp.map_id=m.map_id
             ORDER BY mp.map_file_id) as "planes?: String"
            FROM maps_dom6 m
            WHERE is_randommap IS FALSE
